q: My client is building a new institutional OTC trading business and is looking for a technically strong Product Manager to help deliver an end-to-end trading experience across APIs, digital platforms and voice/chat channels.

This is an exciting opportunity to work closely with Markets, Engineering, Treasury, Compliance and external partners to build and scale institutional trading infrastructure across multiple regulated entities and jurisdictions.
5+ years of experience in Product Management or technical delivery within trading, FX, payments or digital asset infrastructure.
Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, event-driven architecture and settlement workflows.
Proven experience managing third-party vendors and delivering complex technical integrations.
Ability to translate business and trading requirements into clear product specifications.
Strong stakeholder management skills across Markets, Engineering, Treasury, Compliance and Operations.
Experience with OTC trading models, including RFQ and RFS.
Knowledge of stablecoin settlement and institutional digital asset infrastructure.
If you're a technically minded Product Manager who enjoys building complex trading products from the ground up, I'd love to hear from you.
r: Own the product roadmap, translating trading desk requirements into clear specifications, priorities and delivery plans.
Drive end-to-end product delivery across API, GUI and voice/chat trading channels.
Manage integrations with liquidity providers, banking partners, custody providers and order management systems.
Oversee the trade lifecycle, from pricing and execution through hedging, settlement and ledger reconciliation.
Partner with Engineering on REST APIs, WebSocket streaming and event-driven systems.
Work closely with Compliance and Legal to embed regulatory requirements, client onboarding controls and reporting into the product.
Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful testing, integration and go-live.

d: Apt Resources is currently recruiting enthusiastic and dedicated individuals for the position of Waiter/Waitress at an upmarket casual dining restaurant. This vibrant establishment is known for its exceptional service, inviting atmosphere, and a menu that showcases innovative dishes made from high-quality ingredients.

As a Waiter/Waitress, you will be responsible for providing a delightful dining experience for our guests. You will greet customers, take their orders, serve food and beverages, and ensure that their needs are met throughout their visit. Your role is critical in creating a warm and welcoming environment, ensuring that every guest leaves with a memorable experience.
q: Proven experience as a Waiter/Waitress in a casual dining environment, preferably in an upmarket setting
Excellent customer service skills and a friendly, approachable demeanor
Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a team
Knowledge of food and beverage menus and pairing options
Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment
Attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high service standards
Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends
High school diploma or equivalent; relevant training or certifications are a plus
r: Welcome and greet guests promptly upon arrival
Present menus and provide detailed information about menu items, specials, and recommendations
Take accurate food and drink orders using the restaurant's ordering system
Serve orders promptly and monitor guest satisfaction throughout the meal
Prepare tables by setting up linens, utensils, and glassware
Collaborate with kitchen staff to ensure timely and accurate delivery of meals
Address customer inquiries or concerns with professionalism and positivity
Maintain cleanliness and organization of dining areas
Upsell menu items and promote special offers when appropriate
